newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco cuts trade deficit 8.7 pct Jan-Sept 96.
newsitem.headline: Morocco cuts trade deficit 8.7 pct Jan-Sept 96.

text.p: Morocco reduced its trade deficit by 8.7 percent to 19.214 billion dirhams ($2.2 billion) in the first nine months of 1996 from 21.039 billion dirhams in the same previous year period.
The balance reflected a 3.7 percent increase in exports and 0.5 percent cut in imports, official figures showed on Thursday.

Imports were at 61.36 billion dirhams against 61.67 billion in the same period in 1995, according to data from L'Office des Changes (Exchange office). Exports stood at 42.146 billion dirhams compared to 40.636 billion.
